target_customer: Patients with chronic bacterial infections such as cystic fibrosis, and eventually pharma partners and health systems
problem: Antimicrobial resistance makes bacterial infections untreatable; Felix aims to design and deliver phage therapies using a digital viral design platform.
business_model: Therapeutics development funded by equity and grants

founders.name: Robert McBride
founders.background_notes: Named in TechCrunch (March 2020) and the Yale Ventures spotlight; title not given there.

founders.name: Paul Turner
founders.background_notes: Yale Ventures spotlight; YC page lists him as founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Engineering phages with machine learning and synthetic biology and taking an inhaled therapy through clinical trials is research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Licensed phage IP from Yale and clinical data build a position, but phage therapy has several funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; BiomX bought a different phage company, Adaptive Phage Therapeutics, in March 2024 per search results.

market_need_then: Antimicrobial resistance was framed by the company as a coming threat; the CF Foundation grant and a Yale phase 1/2 trial for inhaled phage in cystic fibrosis show clinical interest.

branding.domain_note: Uses felixbt.com; not fetchable in this session.
branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch covered it during the W20 batch; no community or merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Scientific press and grants, but nothing on the brand itself; name resemblance to Felix d'Herelle is plausible but no source says so.

outcome_analysis: Felix spun out of Paul Turner's Yale lab, entered YC in W20, and won grants from the CF Foundation, NSF and NIH while running a Yale phase 1/2 trial of inhaled phage therapy. It said it was mid Series A, but no closing was found. The YC directory marks it inactive although no shutdown or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: Seed rests on one aggregator (VCBacked, which also lists Bossa Invest) and may be the standard YC amount. CF Foundation, NSF and NIH grant details come from search result summaries; NIH date is VCBacked's last recorded funding of July 2022 and NSF date unknown. Series A was said to be in progress (Yale Ventures) with no result found. No dated competitor source near the batch was found; TechCrunch (March 2020) names none.
